## VERIFIED and MERGED — Gerrit 1395, commit 16ad9b069e

All five criteria verified by me against the MERGED tree (`gerrit/main` @ c3fb869ab5), not on the
implementing agent's report.

* **AC1 — dedicated stall error:** `class BackendPaginationStallError(RuntimeError)` at
  `_backend.py:49`. Placed in core so `fetcher` can name it without core importing `adapters/`.
* **AC2 — not swallowed at ANY of the four sites:** re-raised at `_hierarchy.py:96`
  (`get_parent_map`) and at all three `fetch_snapshot` enrichment handlers — `fetcher.py:621`,
  `:668`, `:708`. Exactly the four the criterion names.
* **AC3 — termination within 2 calls:** `test_paged_search_aborts_loudly_when_the_server_ignores_start_at`.
* **AC4 — importable through the facade:** re-exported at `transport.py:59` and listed in `__all__`
  at `:117`, pinned by `test_the_stall_error_is_importable_through_the_transport_facade`.
* **AC5 — well-behaved servers unchanged:** `test_get_parent_map_still_recovers_everything`,
  `test_get_parent_map_degradation_contract_is_preserved` (ordinary failures still yield `{}`), and
  `test_all_three_whole_project_readers_exist_and_page`. Suite: **21 passed, exit 0** on merged main.

### Two things worth keeping from this one

**The obvious fix would have been wrong.** Copying `fetcher._iter_pages`'s short-page branch INVERTS
on DC — this pager exists precisely because a hardened DC caps every page short, so that branch would
have silently returned 20 of 250. The near-miss was mutation-tested and the oracle rejects it.

**`review-plan` blocked the first plan and was right.** It named only `get_parent_map`; in fact all
three DC readers feed `fetch_snapshot`'s three fail-opens and `fetcher.py` named NEITHER stall error,
so a transport-boundary fix would not have resolved the report. That is the third substantive
plan-review block this epic.

### Verification hygiene note

My first verification pass grepped the working tree and found **nothing** — because that checkout sat
at `3b830a514c` while the merged code was on `gerrit/main` @ `c3fb869ab5`. The empty result was a
stale-tree artifact, not evidence of absence. Re-run with `git grep … gerrit/main`, every symbol was
present. Recording it because an empty scan has now produced a false conclusion three times this
session.

Siblings filed and linked: [rebar:9a46-...] (Cloud's `RunawayPaginationError` swallowed by the same
three handlers, so bug cabc's fix is incomplete at that boundary) and [rebar:34c2-...] (the DC
pagination structural guard went vacuous once 465d's split emptied `transport.py` of `search_issues`
call sites). Accepted risk: `fetcher.py` is now 771/800 lines — the next addition there should split.
